The problem

Too many possibilities.
Too little time.

A great rate can hide an empty return trip. A backhaul can put tomorrow’s commitment at risk. Planners weigh these tradeoffs while handling calls, delays, and cancellations.

Our approach

Optimize the whole plan.
Then put it into motion.

Mathematical optimization weighs revenue, costs, forecasts, and driver constraints together. Our AI agents execute the plan and adapt as conditions change.

Meet the team

We know the road.
We’re building what’s next.

Harpreet Dhaliwal

Founder & CEO

Harpreet took over his family’s trucking business at 19 and led its turnaround, restructuring debt, upgrading the fleet, and returning it to profitability. He holds an MS in Data Science.

Daniyar Abykhanov

Founding engineer

Daniyar built voice agents at Kazakhstan’s largest bank that took over the work of a 225-person call center. A former professional Counter-Strike player, he has won three consecutive hackathons, including one run by Google.

Inside our operation

Four agents.
One operation.

01 Sourcing

Finds backhauls and complementary freight around customer commitments and each truck’s next move.

02 Planning

Compares load assignments, routes, and positioning across revenue, costs, available hours, and driver schedules.

03 Dispatch

Coordinates trucks and drivers, preparing new assignments when availability or plans change.

04 Communications

Keeps drivers, brokers, and customers connected through calls, messages, and trip updates.
